claims.statement: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat has two quantity columns, 846 and 801-046. Complete assembly 1134-2469-01 is in 846 column, 1132-0001-02 is in 801-046 column; Park and Trac 12-TRM107 are labels, not replacement authorization.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed

claims.statement: 1991 illustrated listing ties pos.5 30T gear P007-7812-9A and pos.6 20T gear P007-7812-1A to 846; pos.5 31T P000-7781-63 and pos.6 19T P000-7781-62 belong to 801-046. Teeth do not establish full ratio.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed
claims.locator: PDF p.2 pos.5–6, separate model quantity columns

claims.statement: 1991 version columns distinguish two 42T gears at pos.12: 846 P007-7813-7A versus 801-046 P000-7781-54. Matching tooth counts do not imply matching part.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed

claims.statement: 1991 listing differentiates bevel pinion pos.17: P007-7811-3A for 846 versus P000-7781-53 for 801-046.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed

claims.statement: 1991 listing differentiates needle bearing pos.37: P000-7801-11 for 846 versus P000-7801-21 for 801-046.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed

claims.statement: 1991 parts list marks both versions as using two P000-7800-64 bushings at pos.60 and one P000-7801-20 bushing at pos.60A. Shared parts do not prove assembly interchangeability.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed

claims.statement: 1991 parts list has TWO snap rings P000-7921-25 per model at pos.65 (846 and 801-046). This conflicts with older recorded cross-list values where four were implied: do not treat catalog quantities as interchangeable across revisions.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed
claims.locator: PDF p.3 pos.65; quantity columns both 2

claims.statement: In 1991 two-column parts list pos.72 is BRACKET P000-7860-86 in both 846 and 801-046, not a seal. Positions must not be matched directly to later 1993 846 catalog pos.72 seal.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed

claims.statement: 1991 gearbox list pos.77 differentiates 846 snap ring P000-7921-25 (2) and 801-046 thrust washer P000-7800-14 (2), not the same repair part.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed

claims.statement: 1991 listing uses common brake disc P000-7900-03 pos.21, brake plate P000-7900-07 pos.51 and two brake pads P000-7900-06 pos.52 in both 846 and 801-046, despite different brake levers at pos.56.
claims.variant: 1991 STIGA/CyberCat gearbox component comparison with 1990 Park 12 source; model-specific fit unconfirmed

gaps: Den interna transaxellistan kombinerar två kompletta enheter och alternativa komponentrader utan entydig individ-/serienummernyckel. Identifiera transaxelns verkliga skylt och original-BOM före reservdelsval.
Briggs Model/Type/Code och monterad motor ska fastställas på individmotor före motorspecifik service.
Originalbruksanvisning och klippaggregatets PNC samt dess monteringsmanual saknas.
PDF-söktext läst, men webbläsarens PDF-skärmbildsfunktion returnerade fel vid visuell ritningskontroll.

Separat STIGA Park 2002-originalkatalog 1989 identifierar många 846- respektive 801-046-bundna komponenter, men säger inte vilken av dessa växellådor som monterades på varje Park 12 individ 1990. Kräver faktisk transaxelmärkning och relevant maskinkatalog.

STIGA Park 2002 (SF) 1989 skiljer uttryckligen 1132-0001-02 (801-046) och 1134-2469-01 (846) men fastställer inte vilken transaxel som monterats på Park 12 1990-individer. Kräver faktisk märkning och produktbundet monteringsbelägg.

Cross-check 1991 CyberCat 846/801-046 item quantities against each exact year and OEM IPL: pos.65 two snap rings per variant in the 1991 listing; historical catalog quantities may vary by release. Use variant and edition for ordering.
